verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v1: yā rabbi fāsturnā bijāhi l-hādī min kulli ʿaybi rabbi lit-tanādī
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v2: waraḍḍinā l-qaḍāʾa ʾīlu lil-mamāt qad staḥāla fī kalāmika ṣ-ṣumāt
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v3: wayā muṣabbirā binā l-balāyā fakhaffifi l-miḥana war-razāyā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v4: famā lanā min maljaʾi ʾillā ʾilay ka yā muʿīnu rabbanā min kulli shay
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v5: famā lanā min ḥīlati dhā l-ḥiyali munna lanā l-ḥiyala yā rabbi jʿali
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v6: waʾanta qad khalaqta min ʾinsāni muʿallima l-qurʾāni wal-byāni
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v7: wamā bihi nafsu mriʾi tuwaswisu taʿlamuhu mawlāyā yā muʾassisu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v8: waʾanta ʾaqrabu ʿalā ḥabli l-warīd ʾilayhi lā yakūnu ʾillā mā turīd
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v9: famā l-wakālatu lanā siwākā famā lanā l-hudā ʾillā hudākā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v10: fāsluk binā ʾilā sabīli r-rushdi maʿa n-najāti yā ʿalīma qaṣdī
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v11: ʾinnā jaʿalnāka nuḥūra l-ʾaʿdā naʿūdhu min shurūrihimu wal-ʾandā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v12: wayā ḥalīmu yā ʿalīma l-ʾalṭāf fanajjinā yā rabbanā mimmā nakhāf
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v13: lā sahla ʾillā mā jaʿalta sahlā wal-ḥuzna tajʿalanhu sahlā ʾahlā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v14: faʾanta maṭlūbiyā yā ḥamīdu rajāʾuka l-maqṣūdu yā majīdu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v15: yā shāhidā mawlāyā ghayra ghāʾibi wayā qarībā ghāfirā litāʾibi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v16: yā ḥāḍirā ghayra baʿīdi ghālibā waghayra maghlūbi ʾataytu ṭālibā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v17: fājʿal lanā min ʾamrinā min makhraji wafarrijan ʿan ḍīqati waḥaraji
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v18: wārzuq binā min ḥaythu lā naḥtasibu wabārikan mawlāyā mā naktasibu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v19: wāghfir lanā yā rabbi bidh-dhunūbi wathabbiti r-rajāʾa fī l-qulūbi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v20: naḥnu falā narjū siwāka yā ʾila hiyā wajiʾinā nabtaghī minka l-ʾilā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v21: biḥurmahi l-mukhtāri dhī l-mazāyā wal-jāhi war-raḥmahi wal-ʿaṭāyā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v22: war-rusli wal-ʾamlāki wal-muqarrabīn wal-kutbi fī s-samāʾi rabbi ʾajmaʿīn
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v23: wal-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīna l-muhtadīn wal-ʾawliyāʾi ṣ-ṣāliḥīna l-ʿārifīn
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v25: ʾulṭif binā ʿinda maqāsāti l-ʾamūr raybi l-manūni wawaqāʾiʿi d-duhūr
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v26: wāshtaddati l-ʾaḥzānu wal-kurūbu wadārati l-khuṭūbu wil-ḥurūbu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v27: rabbi falā tushmit binā l-ʾaʿdāʾā lā lā walā tūlī binā l-ʾahwāʾā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v28: walā tubāli rabbi bil-mathālibi wakathrati l-marāmi wal-maṭālibi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v29: wakullumā ṭalbtu ʾanta muqtadir ʾanā ʿubaydu wajilu wamuftaqir qaraʿtu bābaka ʾilahī wāqifā walastu ʾin dakhaltu ḍaymā khāʾifā fāftaḥ ʾilahī fātiḥa l-ʾabwābi ʾajib ʾajib musabbiba l-ʾasbābi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v30: yā rabbanā yā rabbanā yā rabbanā yā rabbanā yā rabbanā yā rabbanā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v31: yā rabbanā duʿāʾakum ʾamartā wabiʾijābatikumu waʿadtā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v32: narjū ʾilahiyā biwaʿdi qad ṣafā min baʿdi ʾityāni biʾamri qad shafā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v33: ʿawnaka yā muhayminu l-muʿīnu yā rabbanā wabika nastaʿīnu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v34: yā rabba ʾarbābi wamālika l-mulūk tajrī bika l-ʾaflāku yā khayra s-sulūk
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v35: yā llāhu yā raḥmānu yā dhā l-ʿarshi wayā ḥakīmu yā shadīda l-baṭshi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v36: ʾataytu maʿ biḍāʿati muzjāti ʾilayka ʾinnī fī btighā marḍāti
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v37: bimaḥḍi faḍli minka yā raḥmānu ʾarjū l-qirā yawma l-jazā ḥannānu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v38: fāftaḥ biʾābi r-riḍā t-taysīrā ʾabwāba sharri taghliqan taʿsīrā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v39: ʾanta waliyyunā wamawlānā l-baṣīr faniʿma mawlānā l-ʿalī niʿma n-naṣīr
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v40: wayā laṭīfā lam yazal līfā ʾulṭuf bimā nazala yā ḥafīfā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v41: ʾanta laṭīfu lam tazal dhā luṭfi min ghayri shakki lā walā min khulfi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v42: wāghfir lanā wāghfir liwālidīnā yā llāhu yā rabbi wamuslimīnā
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v43: wārḥamhumu wāsturhumu yā llāhu waqihimu sharra l-jaḥīmi yā hū
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v44: thumma ṣalātu llāhi was-salāmu ʿalā n-nabī mā rasakha s-silāmu
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v45: wāʾālihi waṣaḥbihi l-kirāmi khayri l-qurūni ʾanjumi l-ʾanāmi
verses.ya-rabbi-fasturna-bijahi-l-hadi-c1-v24: waman ʾilā subli l-hudā qad salakū waʿan ṭarīqi l-jahli rabbi tarakū
